guide.instagram: Connect your Instagram there. It has to be a professional account, which Instagram requires to be public.
guide.key: Create an API key limited to one profile, and paste it here.

key.label: {{provider}} API key
key.invalid: That does not look like a key.
key.expired: Your key has expired. What you planned and scheduled is safe. Add a key to carry on.
key.revoke: Forgetting a key removes it from this browser. To cancel it everywhere, use your <site>{{provider}} dashboard</site>.

account.label: Instagram account
account.none: This key has no Instagram account yet.
account.reconnect: This account needs connecting again before anything can be scheduled.

published.failed: Could not load your published posts.

problems.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
problems.not_found: That could not be found. It may have been removed.
problems.validation: Something in this was not valid. Check it and try again.
problems.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problems.origin: This request was blocked. Reload the page and try again.
problems.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
problems.key_missing: Your key has gone. Add it again in Settings.
problems.key_rejected: That key was refused. Check it and try again.
problems.key_not_allowed: This key is not allowed to do that.
problems.profile_required: Choose a profile for this key.
problems.idempotency_required: This request was missing something. Reload the page and try again.
problems.time_in_past: That time has passed. Pick a later one.
problems.provider_busy: This is still being worked on. Try again in a moment.
problems.provider_failed: The scheduling service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
